contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #327: Markov type characterizes superreflexivity.
Source-faithful audit of prop:walks in Nontrivial Markov Type Forces Superreflexivity, staged September 23, 2026 manuscript, Sections 2-5.

definitions.c00: Finitely supported real sequences on natural-number coordinates; changing from one-based manuscript coordinates is an increasing reindexing.
definitions.admissible_norm: A genuine real norm on c00 invariant under increasing coordinate embeddings; merging adjacent coefficients is contractive.
definitions.marked_chain: Finite states and oriented marked edges with an endpoint-reversing involution, nonnegative source-normalized q, probability pi, and pi(src e)q(e)=pi(tgt e)q(reverse e).
definitions.n_step_law: Initial state has law pi; n successive marked edges are chosen with their source-conditional probabilities q. Invalid path arrays have zero mass.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 327 (Markov type characterizes superreflexivity.; papers: Nontrivial Markov Type Forces Superreflexivity; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/327.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
Every real Banach space with Markov type p for some p > 1 is superreflexive; this full theorem remains outside the finite-walk mission.

Every nonsuperreflexive real Banach space finitely represents a spreading-invariant norm on real c00 with contractive adjacent merging, as in lem:ordered-norm and Appendix A; not certified in this mission.
The Markov type inequality transfers with the same constant to sums of odd labels of any finite stationary reversible marked chain, as in lem:edge-labels; not certified in this mission.

For every admissible norm N on real c00 and every natural n with 0 < n, there exist finite states and marked edges, a stationary reversible marked chain, a common finite coordinate bound for all labels, and an odd labeling g with N(g(e))=1 on every edge, such that P(N(sum of the first n labels) >= n/24) >= 3/20.

For every finite ordered landmark set, inverse-paired order-preserving partial bijections, and positive epsilon, finite Ramsey averaging yields reversible stationary chart transport with independent uniform letters and simultaneous chart matching of probability at least 1-epsilon.

The periodic ping-pong action has inverse-odd cocycle cancellation; a word with nonempty reduced form has cocycle values -n_minus and n_plus at the two interlaced orbit families, including all integer translates.

For every positive n, every all-good n-step chart trajectory of positive reduced length ell has raw label-sum norm at least ell/6 times the common raw one-step norm. Negative-letter orientation, half-open prefix cuts, finite-window margins, and endpoint compression are included.

For every positive n, independent uniform four-letter words have reduced length at least n/4 with probability at least 1/4; intersecting all-good chart transport whose failure probability is at most 1/10 gives probability at least 3/20.
A finite marked chain with the stated balance and normalization has total marked path mass one at every time, invalid path mass zero, and a stationary reversible induced state chain.

For every admissible norm N on real c00 and every natural n with 0 < n, there exist finite states and marked edges, a stationary reversible marked chain, a common finite coordinate bound for all labels, and an odd labeling g with N(g(e))=1 on every edge, such that P(N(sum of the first n labels) >= n/24) >= 3/20.

claims.natural_statement: For every admissible norm N on real c00 and every natural n with 0 < n, there exist finite states and marked edges, a stationary reversible marked chain, a common finite coordinate bound for all labels, and an odd labeling g with N(g(e))=1 on every edge, such that P(N(sum of the first n labels) >= n/24) >= 3/20.
claims.formal_statement:
import OAI.Analysis.MarkovType.FiniteWalk

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Campaign9000327

open OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity

noncomputable section

def AllConditions {N : OrderedNorm} {n : ℕ} (W : FiniteWalkWitness N n) : Prop :=
  letI := W.stateFintype
  letI := W.edgeFintype
  (∀ t, ∑ s, W.chain.π s * markedTransition W.chain s t = W.chain.π t) ∧
  (∑ ω : MarkedPath W.State W.Edge n, markedPathWeight W.chain n ω = 1) ∧
  (∀ e, W.label (W.chain.rev e) = -W.label e) ∧
  (∀ e k, W.coordinateBound ≤ k → W.label e k = 0) ∧
  (∀ e, N (W.label e) = 1) ∧
  (3 : ℝ) / 20 ≤ markedProb W.chain n
    (fun ω => (n : ℝ) / 24 ≤ N (edgeSum W.label ω))

theorem prop_walks (N : OrderedNorm) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ W : FiniteWalkWitness N n, AllConditions W := by
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := finiteWalk N n hn
  refine ⟨W, ?_⟩
  letI := W.stateFintype
  letI := W.edgeFintype
  exact ⟨sum_π_mul_P W.chain.toStateChain, sum_markedPathWeight W.chain n,
    W.odd, W.support_bound, W.unit, W.escape⟩

#print axioms prop_walks
#print axioms OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.finiteWalk

end

end Campaign9000327

claims.natural_statement: Every real Banach space with ordinary Markov type p for some real p > 1 admits an equivalent uniformly convex real norm, including the zero space (staged thm:main).
claims.formal_statement:
import OAI.Analysis.MarkovType.MarkovObstruction
import OAI.Analysis.MarkovType.OrderedNormStructural
import OAI.Analysis.MarkovType.OddEdgeTransfer

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Campaign9000327.MainTheorem

open OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {X V : Type*}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]

theorem ordered_norm_construction (hnot : ¬ HasEquivalentUCNorm X) :
    ∃ N : OrderedNorm,
      (∀ x, N x = 0 → x = 0) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (ι : Fin m → ℕ), StrictMono ι →
        ∀ a, N (C00.place ι a) = N (C00.ofArray a)) ∧
      (∀ i x, N (C00.mergeAt i x) ≤ N x) ∧
      CoordinatesRepresentable X N := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := orderedNorm_of_not_hasEquivalentUCNorm hnot
  exact ⟨N, N.definite, fun _ ι hι a => N.spreading ι hι a, N.merge_le, hN⟩

theorem finite_representation_transfer {p K : ℝ}
    (hX : MarkovTypeWith p K X) (hVX : FinitelyRepresentable V X) :
    MarkovTypeWith p K V :=
  hX.of_finitelyRepresentable hVX

theorem odd_edge_transfer {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E]
    {p K : ℝ} (hV : MarkovTypeWith p K V)
    (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (g : E → V) (hg : OddLabel C g)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    markedSumCost C g p n ≤ K ^ p * (n : ℝ) * stationaryEdgeCost C g p :=
  hV.odd_edge_bound C g hg n hn

theorem odd_edge_transfer_span {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E]
    {p K : ℝ} (hX : MarkovTypeWith p K X)
    (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (g : E → V) (hg : OddLabel C g)
    (hspan : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
      ∃ T : (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)) →ₗ[ℝ] X,
        ∀ z, ‖z‖ ≤ ‖T z‖ ∧ ‖T z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖z‖)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    markedSumCost C g p n ≤ K ^ p * (n : ℝ) * stationaryEdgeCost C g p := by
  let g' : E → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) :=
    fun e => ⟨g e, Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self e)⟩
  have hg' : OddLabel C g' := by
    intro e
    exact Subtype.ext (hg e)
  have h := hX.odd_edge_bound_of_embeddings hspan C g' hg' n hn
  simpa [markedSumCost, markedExpect, stationaryEdgeCost, edgeSum, g'] using h

theorem main_implication [CompleteSpace X] (hX : HasNontrivialMarkovType X) :
    HasEquivalentUCNorm X := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, K, hK⟩ := hX
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨N, _, _, _, hN⟩ := ordered_norm_construction hnot
  exact hK.not_coordinatesRepresentable hp N hN

theorem main_explicit [CompleteSpace X] (hX : HasNontrivialMarkovType X) :
    ∃ (q : Seminorm ℝ X) (a b : ℝ), 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧
      (∀ x, a * ‖x‖ ≤ q x ∧ q x ≤ b * ‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 2 → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ x y : X, q x ≤ 1 → q y ≤ 1 → ε ≤ q (x - y) →
          q ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) ≤ 1 - δ) := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := main_implication hX
  exact ⟨N.p, N.lower, N.upper, N.lower_pos, N.upper_pos,
    fun x => ⟨N.lower_bound x, N.upper_bound x⟩, hN⟩

theorem zero_space_case [Subsingleton X] : HasEquivalentUCNorm X :=
  hasEquivalentUCNorm_of_subsingleton

#print axioms ordered_norm_construction
#print axioms odd_edge_transfer
#print axioms odd_edge_transfer_span
#print axioms main_implication
#print axioms main_explicit
#print axioms OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.exists_nonreflexive_finitelyRepresentable_of_not_hasEquivalentUCNorm

end

end Campaign9000327.MainTheorem

    {p K : ℝ} (hV : MarkovTypeWith p K V)
    (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (g : E → V) (hg : OddLabel C g)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    markedSumCost C g p n ≤ K ^ p * (n : ℝ) * stationaryEdgeCost C g p :=

theorem odd_edge_transfer_span {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E]
    {p K : ℝ} (hX : MarkovTypeWith p K X)
    (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (g : E → V) (hg : OddLabel C g)
